Rockstar Games, Travis Scott and Nike are expected to collaborate on three Air Force 1 sneakers for GTA 6.

The sneakers are expected to release on November 19, the same day as GTA 6, for $130 each.

- White & Fire Pink
- Black & Fire Pink
- Multi-Color

GTA 6 is officially 2 Fridays out from launch.

All GTA 6 videos on Rockstar’s YouTube channel have surpassed 600 million views combined.
